# Generated by tools/build_techniques.py.
ac_learn_tech_cleave_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_cleave } }
		add_character_flag = ac_tech_cleave
		send_interface_toast = { type = event_toast_effect_good title = ac_tech_cleave left_icon = this custom_tooltip = ac_tech_cleave_desc }
		add_character_modifier = ac_tech_cleave_modifier
	}
}
ac_learn_tech_hidden_dragon_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_hidden_dragon } }
		add_character_flag = ac_tech_hidden_dragon
		send_interface_toast = { type = event_toast_effect_good title = ac_tech_hidden_dragon left_icon = this custom_tooltip = ac_tech_hidden_dragon_desc }
	}
}
ac_learn_tech_spiritwell_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_spiritwell } }
		add_character_flag = ac_tech_spiritwell
		send_interface_toast = { type = event_toast_effect_good title = ac_tech_spiritwell left_icon = this custom_tooltip = ac_tech_spiritwell_desc }
		ac_init_aura_effect = yes
		change_variable = { name = ac_aura_pressure add = 10 }
	}
}

ac_unfocus_power_effect = {
	if = { limit = { var:ac_focus_power ?= flag:apex_hunter } remove_character_modifier = ac_tech_apex_hunter_focus_modifier }
	if = { limit = { var:ac_focus_power ?= flag:arctic_pillar } remove_character_modifier = ac_tech_arctic_pillar_focus_modifier }
	remove_variable = ac_focus_power
}
ac_unfocus_fortitude_effect = {
	if = { limit = { var:ac_focus_fortitude ?= flag:seismic_closing_palms } remove_character_modifier = ac_tech_seismic_closing_palms_focus_modifier }
	remove_variable = ac_focus_fortitude
}
ac_unfocus_agility_effect = {
	if = { limit = { var:ac_focus_agility ?= flag:mist_clone } remove_character_modifier = ac_tech_mist_clone_focus_modifier }
	if = { limit = { var:ac_focus_agility ?= flag:apex_predator } remove_character_modifier = ac_tech_apex_predator_focus_modifier }
	remove_variable = ac_focus_agility
}
ac_unfocus_soul_effect = {
	if = { limit = { var:ac_focus_soul ?= flag:tenebrous_rift } remove_character_modifier = ac_tech_tenebrous_rift_focus_modifier }
	if = { limit = { var:ac_focus_soul ?= flag:daggerfalling_hailstorm } remove_character_modifier = ac_tech_daggerfalling_hailstorm_focus_modifier }
	remove_variable = ac_focus_soul
}
ac_focus_tech_cleave_effect = {
	ac_unfocus_power_effect = yes
	set_variable = { name = ac_focus_power value = flag:cleave }
}

# Learn one Technique you can learn, at random (Path Manuals, sect libraries, AI).
ac_learn_random_technique_effect = {
	random_list = {
		10 = { trigger = { ac_can_learn_tech_cleave_trigger = yes } modifier = { add = 10 ac_core_power_rating >= 4 } modifier = { add = 20 always = no } ac_learn_tech_cleave_effect = yes }
		10 = { trigger = { ac_can_learn_tech_hidden_dragon_trigger = yes } modifier = { add = 10 ac_core_power_rating >= 4 } modifier = { add = 20 always = no } ac_learn_tech_hidden_dragon_effect = yes }
		10 = { trigger = { ac_can_learn_tech_spiritwell_trigger = yes } modifier = { add = 10 ac_core_power_rating >= 4 } modifier = { add = 20 always = no } ac_learn_tech_spiritwell_effect = yes }

# Innate Techniques awaken when a Core reaches rating 5 (Thunderfall, Iron Body, Flash Step, Energy Tide).
ac_grant_innate_techniques_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_trait = ac_cultivator NOT = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_thunderfall } ac_core_power_rating >= 5 }
		add_character_flag = ac_tech_thunderfall
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			send_interface_toast = { type = event_toast_effect_good title = ac_tech_thunderfall left_icon = this custom_tooltip = ac_tech_thunderfall_desc }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_trait = ac_cultivator NOT = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_iron_body } ac_core_fortitude_rating >= 5 }
		add_character_flag = ac_tech_iron_body
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			send_interface_toast = { type = event_toast_effect_good title = ac_tech_iron_body left_icon = this custom_tooltip = ac_tech_iron_body_desc }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_trait = ac_cultivator NOT = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_flash_step } ac_core_agility_rating >= 5 }
		add_character_flag = ac_tech_flash_step
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			send_interface_toast = { type = event_toast_effect_good title = ac_tech_flash_step left_icon = this custom_tooltip = ac_tech_flash_step_desc }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_trait = ac_cultivator NOT = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_energy_tide } ac_core_soul_rating >= 5 }
		add_character_flag = ac_tech_energy_tide
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			send_interface_toast = { type = event_toast_effect_good title = ac_tech_energy_tide left_icon = this custom_tooltip = ac_tech_energy_tide_desc }
		}
	}
}
ac_ai_focus_techniques_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_focus_power } }
		if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_cleave } ac_focus_tech_cleave_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_hidden_dragon } ac_focus_tech_hidden_dragon_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_spiritwell } ac_focus_tech_spiritwell_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_palm_of_endless_beating } ac_focus_tech_palm_of_endless_beating_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_wrathful_fist } ac_focus_tech_wrathful_fist_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_inferno } ac_focus_tech_inferno_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_shockblast } ac_focus_tech_shockblast_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_apex_hunter } ac_focus_tech_apex_hunter_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_arctic_pillar } ac_focus_tech_arctic_pillar_effect = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_focus_fortitude } }
		if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_sacred_armor } ac_focus_tech_sacred_armor_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_chi_hardened_skin } ac_focus_tech_chi_hardened_skin_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_frostguard } ac_focus_tech_frostguard_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_sandshield } ac_focus_tech_sandshield_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_blade_barrier } ac_focus_tech_blade_barrier_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_sacred_breathing } ac_focus_tech_sacred_breathing_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_crouching_tiger } ac_focus_tech_crouching_tiger_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_seismic_closing_palms } ac_focus_tech_seismic_closing_palms_effect = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_focus_agility } }
		if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_danger_sense } ac_focus_tech_danger_sense_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_iaijutsu } ac_focus_tech_iaijutsu_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_bloodhunt } ac_focus_tech_bloodhunt_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_wavewalking } ac_focus_tech_wavewalking_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_grand_skyfall } ac_focus_tech_grand_skyfall_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_imbued_bodyhammer } ac_focus_tech_imbued_bodyhammer_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_mist_clone } ac_focus_tech_mist_clone_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_apex_predator } ac_focus_tech_apex_predator_effect = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_focus_soul } }
		if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_zen_focus } ac_focus_tech_zen_focus_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_commanding_presence } ac_focus_tech_commanding_presence_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_prayer_talisman } ac_focus_tech_prayer_talisman_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_poisonmaster } ac_focus_tech_poisonmaster_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_combat_seals } ac_focus_tech_combat_seals_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_midnight_blade } ac_focus_tech_midnight_blade_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_searing_light } ac_focus_tech_searing_light_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_tenebrous_rift } ac_focus_tech_tenebrous_rift_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_fox_charm } ac_focus_tech_fox_charm_effect = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { has_character_flag = ac_tech_daggerfalling_hailstorm } ac_focus_tech_daggerfalling_hailstorm_effect = yes }
	}
}
